purpose: Universal prompt frameworks for user-entered custom product categories/subcategories. These are creative directions, not product facts.
selection: Match the selected visual style to a framework. Never infer product functions or claims from the framework.

frameworks.name: Paparan produk premium
frameworks.direction: Create a restrained premium hero presentation: begin with a clear view of the exact product, make one gentle camera move, highlight only one visible detail, then hold a clean full-product hero frame. Use soft controlled light and realistic contact shadows; no dramatic spin or fabricated view.

frameworks.name: Paparan katalog minimal
frameworks.direction: Use a clean uncluttered composition with generous negative space and stable framing. Keep the full product readable, use subtle light and a small push-in only if it preserves geometry, then finish on a still hero view. Do not add props, captions or graphic marks unless the chosen style explicitly requests them.

frameworks.name: Gaya kehidupan sebenar
frameworks.direction: Place the exact product in a believable context suited to the user-provided category, without guessing its specific use. Show one simple, natural interaction only when the use is clear; otherwise let the environment provide context. Keep scale, lighting and product identity consistent.

frameworks.name: Susunan dan paparan kemas
frameworks.direction: Arrange the product in a tidy, balanced composition using only items already visible or explicitly confirmed as included. Use a gentle overhead or near-overhead camera drift, preserve the original silhouette and packaging, and end with a clear view of the complete product.

frameworks.name: Unboxing berhati-hati
frameworks.direction: If the reference clearly shows packaging that can be opened, reveal only what is visible or confirmed; otherwise present the packaged product without inventing contents. Use slow, practical hand movement, consistent packaging details and a clean final product view. No surprise accessories or unsupported claims.

frameworks.name: Hook visual dan reveal
frameworks.direction: Open with an interesting but truthful framing or light reveal, not a false result or exaggerated effect. Reveal the complete product early, show one visible detail, then settle into a polished hero shot. Keep transitions restrained and never morph, duplicate or make the product fly.

frameworks.name: Gerakan kamera terkawal
frameworks.direction: Use one controlled camera move—slow push-in, short lateral slide or a limited arc only when the visible reference supports it. Do not perform a full rotation or reveal unseen sides. Keep the product stationary, proportions stable and edges free from warping.

frameworks.name: Fokus pada perincian
frameworks.direction: Show the full product first, then move toward one genuinely visible texture, control, seam, finish or other detail without naming an unverified material or feature. Return to a recognizable full-product view. If a close-up risks distortion, use a safe crop instead.

global_rules: Use the uploaded product image as the source of truth for visible shape, colour, print, packaging, proportions and branding.
Use custom category/subcategory text only as context; do not assume a function, specification, included accessory, material, certification, benefit or claim.
Use realistic lighting, natural movement and coherent setting; avoid CGI/plastic appearance, flicker, warping and abrupt scene changes.
No unrequested on-screen text, subtitles, logos, watermarks or promotional claims.
For a 10-second clip: reveal product by 2 seconds, show one visible detail around 4–6 seconds, use one simple appropriate action or camera move, and hold a clear hero frame at 8–10 seconds.
